summary: Use Number Pagination to show which slide of a short media carousel is in view, and to jump to another.

useWhen.text: Show which slide of a short media carousel is in view, and let people jump to another.

from.quote: Use Number Pagination to show which slide of a short media carousel is in view, and to jump to another.

useWhen.text: A photo carousel on a product card.

from.quote: A photo carousel on a product card

avoidWhen.text: On a light surface: the white numbers disappear on white.

from.quote: White numbers disappear on white.

avoidWhen.text: Showing every page of a long set: twelve pages don't fit, so people have to scroll the numbers to find the rest.

from.quote: Twelve pages don’t fit, so people must scroll the numbers to find the rest.

anatomy.holds: Frosted, translucent surface with a thin light border; it holds one circular number per page.

from.quote: Frosted, translucent surface with a thin light border.

anatomy.holds: White circle with a dark number for the slide in view (activePage).

from.quote: White circle with a dark number for the slide in view.

anatomy.holds: Other pages in white; each is a 32 px pressable circle.

from.quote: Other pages in white; each is a 32 px pressable circle.
A few pages, over imagery.

placementAdvice.text: Place it on imagery: white numbers stand out on a photo.

from.quote: White numbers stand out on a photo.

placementAdvice.text: Number Pagination is 39 px tall and grows by 32 px for each page: four pages are about 138 px wide.

from.quote: Number Pagination is 39 px tall and grows by 32 px for each page: four pages are about 138 px wide.

placementAdvice.text: It does not wrap: pages that do not fit scroll sideways inside the glass background.

from.quote: It does not wrap: pages that do not fit scroll sideways inside the glass background.

configuration.text: Set how many pages with totalPages; each page adds a 32 px circle.

from.quote: Each page adds a 32 px circle.

configuration.text: Keep the count small so Number Pagination stays compact over the image.

from.quote: Keep the count small so Number Pagination stays compact over the image.

configuration.text: Three pages for a short set, such as three offers.

from.quote: For a short set, such as three offers.

configuration.text: Four pages is the Figma default.

from.quote: The Figma default.

configuration.text: Five pages is about the most that stays compact.

from.quote: About the most that stays compact.

configuration.text: In the package totalPages and activePage both default to 1, so a pagination with neither set shows a single number.
The screen tracks the page and passes it as activePage (1-based); the component shows it.

from.quote: The screen tracks the page; the component shows it.

configuration.text: The screen passes the active page (activePage) and updates it when a number is pressed.

from.quote: The screen passes the active page and updates it when a number is pressed.

configuration.text: Number Pagination only reports the press: onPageChange gives the page pressed, and the screen shows that slide and passes it back as activePage.

from.quote: Number Pagination only reports the press.
There is no disabled state.
It has no arrows

configuration.text: children replaces the default page buttons; activePage and totalPages are then ignored. The guide doesn’t show custom children.

rules.text: The component writes the numbers from the page count (totalPages); there is no text to add.

from.quote: The component writes the numbers from the page count; there is no text to add.

rules.text: Let the image or card above say what each slide is.

from.quote: Let the image or card above say what each slide is.

states.when: The page the screen passes as activePage is the white circle; the white circle follows the page as the screen updates it.

from.quote: The white circle follows the page

states.when: Every other page: a white number; each is a 32 px pressable circle.

from.quote: Other pages in white; each is a 32 px pressable circle.

states.when: A number dims to 70% while it is pressed.

from.quote: Pressed numbers dim to 70%.

accessibility.text: On the web the active page is announced as the current page, and the numbers are grouped under the name “Pagination”.

from.quote: On the web the active page is announced as the current page, and the numbers are grouped under the name “Pagination”.

accessibility.text: accessibilityLabel names the group of numbers; it defaults to “Pagination”.
Each number is a button named “Page n”; on the web Enter presses it.

from.quote: Pages: `button` 32 × 32 named "Page n", Enter activates

doDont.dont: Place it on a light surface

from.quote: White numbers stand out on a photo.

doDont.dont: Show every page of a long set
doDont.why: Twelve pages don’t fit, so people must scroll the numbers to find the rest.

from.quote: Five numbers fit comfortably.

examples.purpose: A photo carousel on a product card, the guide's In context: four photos with the first in view. The screen draws the photo and puts Number Pagination over it (the component draws only the numbers); it passes activePage and, when a number is pressed, onPageChange gives that page; the screen shows that photo and passes the page back.

from.quote: The screen passes activePage and, when a number is pressed, shows that photo

examples.purpose: A short set, such as three offers: three pages, the first in view.

from.quote: For a short set, such as three offers.

examples.purpose: Five pages, about the most that stays compact, with the last slide in view: the white circle moves to the last number.

from.quote: About the most that stays compact.

props.name: activePage
props.description: On the web the page with this number has aria-current="page", so it is announced as the current page. Declared: The 1-based active page index. Ignored if `children` is supplied. Defaults to 1. Default 1, from the component source.

props.name: totalPages
props.description: Pages that don't fit scroll sideways inside the glass background: twelve pages in a 360 px host scroll horizontally, and the last page can be scrolled into view. Declared: The total number of pages. Ignored if `children` is supplied. Defaults to 1. Default 1, from the component source.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description: Callback fired when a page button is pressed. Ignored if `children` is supplied.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom children to override the default page buttons.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: On the web the container is a navigation landmark (nav) named “Pagination” by default; on native it is a toolbar. Declared: Accessible name for the pagination group. Defaults to `"Pagination"`. Default "Pagination", from the component source.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Custom children to override the default page buttons.

events.name: onPageChange
events.description: Callback fired when a page button is pressed. Ignored if `children` is supplied.

gaps.text: Number Pagination has no arrows and no disabled state; pages that do not fit scroll inside the glass background.
Figma's four-page Number Pagination is 136 px wide; the package's is 138 px, because its 1 px border is added.
